title: Argument
description: Input/output argument of a function or a stored procedure.

mode.description: Optional. Specifies whether the argument is input or output. Can be set for procedures only.

name.description: Optional. The name of this argument. Can be absent for function return argument.

isAggregate.description: Optional. Whether the argument is an aggregate function parameter. Must be Unset for routine types other than AGGREGATE_FUNCTION. For AGGREGATE_FUNCTION, if set to false, it is equivalent to adding "NOT AGGREGATE" clause in DDL; Otherwise, it is equivalent to omitting "NOT AGGREGATE" clause in DDL.
